Ticket #8841 is the one Gideon closed with support on 1 Jul at 09:17. According to his post, the fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, which Vantorre's IT did. After that, the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team. I replied in #strategic-pod.

The brain's notes describe #8841 differently: a Dock Door 14 kiosk problem in a 30 Sep digest, and a Door 12 kiosk timeout in a 4 May digest. I couldn't confirm which is right from the ticket itself, so check the ticket before the QBR.
